question: Can the token-free NativeContinuousHybrid learn genuinely context-reversing action effects from factual action-to-next-continuous-state data, then choose source actions for opposite caller goals more accurately than a matched-capacity shuffled-action sham and a fixed policy, while approaching a fully trained conventional MLP and factual ridge baseline?
status_limits: Authored synthetic mathematical world, not independent external physical science, not full Mamba2+Attention+TTT, not FORGE training, not general intelligence, not proof of self-generated goals.

authored_source.name: authored_cue_reversing_continuous_actuator_v1
authored_source.cue_regions: balanced negative [-0.95,-0.55] and positive [0.55,0.95] in train, heldout cues [-0.99,-0.45] and [0.45,0.99]
authored_source.source_step_real_only: Only true authored source step() returns next position; policy and learner see only preaction sensor and factual chosen-action outcome, no oracle future counterfactuals at training
authored_source.source_matches_P26_P27: Distinct: native token-free continuous-state model and dual opposing goals with matched factual source actions; no reused P26/P27 data or claims.

learning.native_state_policy: one independently reset factual native continuous state per source transition; this first P38 study tests conditional dynamics learning, not multi-step persistence/TTT adaptation
learning.mlp_architecture: nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(3,24),nn.Tanh(),nn.Linear(24,24),nn.Tanh(),nn.Linear(24,2)); output is delta sensor; total params 746 versus native 734
learning.real_training_input: Only [x,cue,actual_executed_action] continuous float32; true next source [x_next,cue_next] observed after stepping source. dt=1
learning.loss: Mean squared error on factual next 2-dimensional continuous source observation; no expert action labels, no goal imitation, no prefilled physics coefficients
learning.sampling_schedule: same factual source examples, same deterministic training example index order across three neural arms and model seed; negative sham deterministically permutes action INPUT per minibatch per epoch, leaving source true target and sensor unchanged
learning.ridge_features: [1, x, cue, a, a*cue, a*sin(3*x), sin(5*x)] and ridge penalty 0.0001. Train on same factual transitions; analytical fully fitted conventional baseline with different optimization cost reported separately.
learning.checkpoints: The final frozen epoch state only. Save all 3 model seeds x 3 trained neural arms; no best heldout model picking, no retry if objective fails.

evaluation.goal_selector: For each goal direction, use P37 select_goal_action with same two candidate actions, caller-supplied goal sensor [x + direction*0.32,cue]; conventional MLP and fitted ridge evaluate identical two candidates; choose smaller predicted squared goal distance; deterministic ties choose action -1
evaluation.true_success: Compare selected action against best actual outcomes of BOTH independently executed authored source actions on SAME heldout public state (source action-to-consequence correctness); measured true reward = negative absolute distance to target. No access to unexecuted actual outcomes by policy.
